title: CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging Antibody Conjugation and Validation
author: Diane Saunders
materials: Gather reagents: CODEX® Conjugation Kit Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000009 50kDa MWCO filter Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #UFC505096 Oligonucleotide barcodes (Akoya Biosciences) 50 μg each primary antibody to be conjugated (vendor of choice) ⓘ For an overview of the conjugation workflow, see Conjugating CODEX® tags on antibodies of choice (Akoya Biosciences).
Reduce antibodies by applying 260 µL Reduction Master Mix to each filter/tube unit and incubating for 00:30:00 at room temperature. Centrifuge 12.000 x g, °C, 8 minutes and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Measure antibody concentration and prepare sample
steps.instruction: Measure the actual concentration of each antibody using a NanoDrop™ or comparable system, calculate the volume needed to obtain 50 µg, and adjust to a minimum total volume of 100 µL (diluting with 1X PBS if necessary).

steps.title: Block filter and pre‑spin antibody
steps.instruction: Label one tube and one filter per antibody. Add 500 µL Filter Blocking Solution to each filter, then centrifuge at 12,000 × g, °C, for 2 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Prepare and attach oligonucleotide barcodes
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL nuclease‑free water to each barcode vial, then add 210 µL Conjugation Solution and pipet up/down gently to dissolve. Transfer the suspended barcode onto the top of the corresponding filter unit, briefly vortex, and incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00. Centrifuge at 12,000 × g, °C, for 8 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash filter with purification solution (3×)
steps.instruction: Add 450 µL Purification Solution to the top of each filter unit, centrifuge at 12,000 × g, °C, for 8 min and discard the flow‑through. Repeat this wash two additional times for a total of three washes/spins.

steps.title: Elute conjugated antibody into storage solution
steps.instruction: Label a new collection tube, add 100 µL Antibody Storage Solution to each filter unit, place the tube face‑down on the filter, invert the apparatus to collect eluate, then centrifuge at 3,000 × g, °C, for 2 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Transfer and label conjugated antibody for storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the ~120 µL conjugated antibody to a screw‑top storage tube, label as "AB‑BX###" with conjugation date and antibody lot number, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform CODEX staining protocol up to step 20
steps.instruction: Follow the CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging Tissue Staining and Reporter Plate Preparation protocol through step 20 as described by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Prepare screening buffer and aliquot to plates
steps.instruction: Prepare Screening Buffer for 4 samples (total 40 mL): 28 mL ddH₂O, 8 mL DMSO, 4 mL 10X CODEX buffer. Transfer 3 mL aliquots of the buffer into each well of 6‑well plates.

steps.title: Wash coverslips three times with screening buffer
steps.instruction: Move each coverslip through three successive washes, adding one 3 mL aliquot of Screening Buffer per wash.

steps.title: Prepare reporter stock solution
steps.instruction: For 4 samples (total 400 µL): combine 379 µL 1X CODEX buffer, 20 µL assay reagent, and 1 µL nuclear stain. Use an Excel sheet as described to calculate volumes for other sample numbers (up to 12).

steps.title: Make reporter mix for each coverslip
steps.instruction: In a light‑protected microcentrifuge tube, mix 100 µL Reporter Stock Solution (RSS) with 2.5 µL of each CODEX® barcoded reporter (RX); add up to three different reporters per coverslip.

steps.title: Apply reporter mix to coverslips and incubate
steps.instruction: Affix a piece of parafilm to the bench with lab tape, label spaces for each coverslip, pipet the reporter mixes onto the labeled spots, place each coverslip face‑down onto its drop using bent‑tip tweezers, cover with a light‑protective lid, and incubate for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Repeat screening buffer washes after reporter incubation
steps.instruction: Perform three additional washes of each coverslip with Screening Buffer (reuse the aliquots from the earlier wash step).

steps.title: Mount coverslips on slides for imaging
steps.instruction: Mount each coverslip face‑down onto a microscope slide using either 10 µL of 1X CODEX buffer or Invitrogen™ SlowFade™ Gold Antifade Mountant (Fisher Scientific Catalog #S36936).

steps.title: Validate primary antibody efficacy via indirect IF
steps.instruction: Assess the efficacy of the primary antibody using an indirect immunofluorescence protocol (e.g., steps 1‑20 of Immunofluorescent Staining of Mouse Pancreas). Ensure antibodies are free of additives such as BSA or glycerol; low concentrations of sodium azide are permissible.
